criticism: The receiveApproval function does not check for integer overflow when transferring tokens from the approved spender to the receiver.
The transfer function does not check for integer overflow when transferring tokens from the sender to the receiver.
The transferFrom function does not check for integer overflow when transferring tokens from the sender to the receiver.
The generateTokens function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the user.
The destroyTokens function does not check for integer overflow when subtracting tokens from the balance of the user.
The freeze function does not check for integer overflow when subtracting tokens from the balance of the user.
The unFreeze function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the user.
The changeOwner function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the new owner.
The changeTokensPerEther function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the controller.
The changeAirdropQty function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the controller.
The changeAirdropTotalQty function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the controller.
The changePaused function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the controller.
The fallback function does not check for integer overflow when adding tokens to the balance of the user.
